automatic_exact_duplicate_evidence: equal positive GitHub repository numeric ID and equal pull-request number
equal positive GitHub repository numeric ID and equal exact repair commit SHA
a PR-linked merge_commit_sha exactly equal to another source's repair commit SHA in the same repository numeric ID

canonical_candidate_id.later_source_rule: attach provenance to the existing content-addressed ID; never renumber

conflict_rule: equal repository ID and PR number with conflicting captured repair SHAs is IDENTITY_CONFLICT and fails closed; it is not auto-collapsed

missing_fields.behavior: never wildcard-match null, empty, absent, or unresolved fields
missing_fields.candidate_materialization: reject when repository numeric ID, candidate snapshot, or repair SHA is required but absent
missing_fields.possible_duplicate: preserve both source records and candidates when each is independently materializable; record POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE when only mutable or incomplete evidence suggests overlap
